wordstat_gate.rule: Always evaluate Klyshin hook via Wordstat; weak volume → rework (localize Tyumen, buyer jargon, similar queries) until buyer P0 cluster; skip only after rework exhausted (not brand vanity)

localize_rule: Facts and city = Святослав Шакин / Тюмень. Do not copy Moscow/Dubai/МКАД as P0.
